DXCC 实体约 340 个，其中部分常年无人设台。: There are about 340 DXCC entities, some of which go for years without any station active.
利用传播预测选择最佳时间与波段冲击稀有实体。: Use propagation predictions to choose the best time and band for attempting a rare entity.
把最想要的实体加入守候列表，关注其远征动态。: Add the entities you most want to a watch list and follow their DXpedition news.
按全球需求排行的稀有 DXCC 实体榜单，反映稀有程度。: A ranking of rare DXCC entities by global demand, reflecting how rare each one is.
由 Club Log 等平台根据全球通联日志统计活跃度。: Platforms such as Club Log compute activity from worldwide contact logs.
稀有台出现时按分区耐心等待，不要反复无序呼叫。: When a rare station appears, wait patiently by zone; do not call over and over at random.
稀有实体一旦有远征队出现，会吸引全球 pileup。: As soon as a DXpedition activates a rare entity it draws a worldwide pileup.
通联成功后及时确认（LoTW / QSL），避免错失奖状进度。: Confirm promptly after a successful contact (LoTW / QSL) so award progress is not lost.
